Only show settings when using a hidden account
Hidden accounts use a separate 4-digit unlock code. When app passcode is enabled, entering a hidden account code on the passcode prompt opens that account for the current session.
Stealth mode hides hidden accounts without enabling the regular app passcode. Enter a hidden account code in the chat search field to open that account for the current session.
Enable Telegram passcode or stealth mode before hiding accounts.

Only hidden accounts get an extra unlock code. At least one account must remain visible.\n\nThe unlock code controls in-app access only. It is not encryption — chat data, media, and credentials remain readable to anyone with full device access (root, backup extraction, or a compromised system).
You can\'t disable stealth mode while hidden accounts exist and app passcode is off.
You can\'t disable app passcode while hidden accounts exist unless stealth mode is enabled.
At least one signed-in account must stay visible.
This account will become visible again in account switchers, settings, and notifications.
Enter the current unlock code before changing this hidden account.
Use a separate 4-digit code for this account. Hidden account codes must be unique and cannot match the app passcode.

Mercurygram will no longer check for updates on GitHub at startup. You can still trigger a manual check from the button below.

Receive 5-dotted pre-release builds (such as 12.6.4.4.42) via the in-app updater. These are development snapshots taken between stable releases; they may contain crashes, partially-working features, or other regressions. You can disable this option later to roll back to the matching 4-dotted stable.

Pre-release Mercurygram builds (5-dotted, such as 12.6.4.4.42) are development snapshots produced between stable releases. They may contain undiscovered crashes, partially-working features, or other regressions. You can disable this option later to roll back to the matching 4-dotted stable. Continue?
Send only the still photo when picking a Google Motion Photo. You can still enable Live Photo for an individual selection by tapping the motion icon in the attach panel.
Replace the bundled Roboto fonts with the device system fonts. Existing screens may need to be reopened for the change to fully apply.

Deleted messages stay in the chat, grayed out and non-replyable; edited messages keep their previous versions accessible from the message menu. Stored separately from the Telegram cache. Self-destructing messages and secret chats are never saved.
Permanently delete all saved deleted and edited messages?
When disabled, Mercurygram falls back to polling for new messages. The app will restart to apply the change.
Mercurygram needs to restart to apply this change. Continue?
Refreshes the session key every hour instead of once a day. Makes passive correlation of your device harder. Background network activity will be slightly higher.

Mercurygram will rotate the session key every hour instead of once a day. This makes it harder for a passive observer on your network to correlate your device, but does not hide that you use Telegram and does not defeat traffic analysis (timing, volume, contacts). The first session key on a fresh login is still observable once, and background network activity will be slightly higher. Continue?
Account %1$s reverted to standard mode — server rejected the reduced session-key lifetime.
Server rejected the reduced session-key lifetime for: %1$s. Those accounts use the standard 24h key. Turn off and on to retry.
Tor crashed repeatedly. Auto-restart paused — toggle Tor off and on to retry.
Tor plugin not installed. Install it to enable Tor.

Routes Telegram protocol traffic (MTProto) through an embedded Tor daemon to defeat the passive auth_key_id tracking that lets network operators link your account to your real IP. Media downloads and other HTTP traffic stay direct so the app stays responsive. Tor disconnects automatically when the app is idle to save battery and restarts when needed. Latency-sensitive features (calls) may suffer; Telegram still sees the Tor exit.

Mercurygram will start an embedded Tor daemon and route Telegram protocol traffic (MTProto) through it. Media downloads and other HTTP traffic stay direct. Bootstrap takes ~10–30 seconds the first time. Tor shuts down automatically when the app has been idle to save battery, and starts again on resume or when a push arrives. Continue?

Where a network blocks Tor directly (as in Russia and Iran), pick Snowflake to route the Tor handshake through a domain-fronted relay so it can still connect, with no setup. Or pick obfs4 bridges if you have bridge lines from @GetBridgesBot. Direct connection is fastest where Tor is not blocked.
Paste obfs4 bridge lines, one per line. Get them from @GetBridgesBot on Telegram.
No valid obfs4 bridge found. Each line must start with \"obfs4\". Get bridges from @GetBridgesBot on Telegram.
